description: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.
Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
progress: You look a sturdy type, <class>. Have you come to join our fight?
completion: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
